chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, who said:
I wrote to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام and complained to him about the frequent earthquakes in al-Ahwāz, and I said: Do you consider relocation away from it advisable for me?

So he عليه السلام wrote: “Do not move away from it. Fast on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, perform ghusl, purify your clothes, go out on Friday, and supplicate to Allah, for He will lift it from you.”
He said: So we did that, and the earthquakes became still.

key_terms.التَّحْوِيلَ: relocating or moving away from a place
key_terms.الزَّلَازِلِ: earthquakes occurring repeatedly in the region

ai.seo_question: What did Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام instruct people to do when frequent earthquakes occurred?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār wrote to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about recurring earthquakes in al-Ahwāz and asked whether he should leave. The Imam عليه السلام instructed them to remain, fast on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, perform ghusl, purify their clothes, and make du'a to Allah on Friday; when they acted upon this, the earthquakes subsided.
